obstaclePanel.applyTip: Upload obstacles as exclusion fences and enable avoidance + path planning
obstaclePanel.clearFcTip: Clear all fences on the flight controller
obstaclePanel.openTip: Author obstacles and push them to the FC as exclusion fences
obstaclePanel.title: Obstacles

gpsDenied.label: GPS denied
gpsDenied.tip: Disable GPS to trigger the GPS-loss failsafe / EKF fallback (SIM_GPS1_ENABLE 0)

radioLoss.label: Radio loss
radioLoss.tip: Drop RC to trigger the radio failsafe (SIM_RC_FAIL 1)

streamControl.tip: Publish the 3D view as an RTSP stream for OpenCV, VLC or ffmpeg

testPanel.attachTip: Attach (or update) a slung load on a cable below the aircraft
testPanel.battTip: Pack voltage (SIM_BATT_VOLTAGE) - drop toward the failsafe threshold to test low-battery actions
testPanel.builtinTip: Built-in ArduPilot SITL physics: conditions set via SIM_* parameters
testPanel.clickArmHint: Click an arm to fail that motor. Live faults are echoed from the engine.
testPanel.engineTip: ArduDeck physics engine is driving the sim: motors, wind and payload are set live
testPanel.glitchTip: Inject a horizontal position offset (SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_X/Y) to test glitch rejection / flyaway
testPanel.gpsFixTip: Disable to test the GPS-loss failsafe / EKF fallback (SIM_GPS1_ENABLE)
testPanel.lowerTip: Pay out the winch (lower the load)
testPanel.openTip: Rehearse a flight: inject motor faults, payload, wind, GPS/nav and sensor failures
testPanel.raiseTip: Reel in the winch (raise the load)
testPanel.rcLossTip: Drop RC to trigger the radio failsafe (SIM_RC_FAIL)
testPanel.resetAllTip: Restore all conditions to safe defaults
testPanel.satsTip: Reported satellite count (SIM_GPS1_NUMSATS); drop below the arming minimum to degrade the fix
testPanel.severityTip: How bad the next injected fault is (0-100%)
testPanel.thrustTip: Remaining thrust on failed motors (SIM_ENGINE_MUL): 0% = dead, else partial loss
testPanel.title: Test Conditions
testPanel.vibeTip: Motor-driven vibration amplitude (SIM_VIB_MOT_MAX, m/s/s) - high values clip the IMU
testPanel.waitingLayout: Waiting for the motor layout from the engine ({{count}} motors)...

camera.chaseTip: Follow behind the vehicle along its heading
camera.orbitTip: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom

worldView.connectedHint: The vehicle will appear here once it has a position fix. Any connected SITL or aircraft works. The ArduDeck sim engine is optional.
worldView.disconnectedHint: Connect to SITL (or a vehicle) from the main window and it will appear here.
worldView.dragTip: Drag to move - magnets to panel & window edges
worldView.fleetOpsNoEngine: Multi-vehicle ops run over the engine. Start the multi-vehicle engine from the connection screen to take off and form up the whole fleet together. Single-vehicle commands stay on the bar below.
worldView.gridTip: Reference grid: a spatial-perception aid that stays visible over both the flat ground and the SVT terrain
worldView.hudTip: FPV HUD overlay: boresight, pitch/roll horizon ladder, airspeed/altitude, heading and climb rate (FPV & Chase views)
worldView.hudUnavailableTip: HUD is only available in FPV & Chase views
worldView.motorBarsTip: Per-motor output (bar height = throttle command, colour = arm load)
worldView.terrainFetchFailed: Terrain elevation fetch failed - check the network and retry
worldView.terrainNeedsOrigin: Terrain needs a GPS origin - wait for a position fix
worldView.terrainSharedNote: Shared with synthetic vision. The ground nearest the vehicle always uses the sharpest imagery.
worldView.terrainTip: Show real elevation terrain (synthetic vision) under the vehicles

tile.armMaxTip: Worst per-arm bending moment (thrust x arm length)
tile.dragTip: Airframe parasitic + rotor momentum drag (orange arrow)
tile.loadTip: Airframe load factor (specific force / g). 1.0 in level hover; higher in pull-ups / hard turns
tile.netTip: Net resultant force accelerating the airframe (white arrow); near zero in a steady hover

worldView.waypointsTip: Conformal 3D waypoint markers: target reticles floating at each waypoint's true position + altitude, with number and live slant-range
worldView.xrayTip: Physics X-ray: force budget through the CG (thrust, weight, drag, net resultant), per-motor arrows, CG markers and g-load (ArduDeck sim engine only)
